author: Seth Godin
description: That’s the appeal of it, of course. There isn’t a definitive study. There can’t be. Even if we created a forty-year-long, double-blind twin study, there’d be room for someone to ask “what about?…” It doesn’t matter that the peer-reviewed and consistent results we have are clear to those who read them with an open mind. […]
title: The definitive study of seed oil and health
